Before I pray, could I just give a word of salutation? First, to the Speaker of this City Council, Adrienne Adams, and to the Members of the City Council, ladies and gentlemen, I want to salute everyone of you. And I'm here today, and I'm very proud of a young man, Kevin Christopher Riley. I remember, I held him in my hands right there in the Bronx, District 12. And I prayed for him and baptized him. And I'm proud to see that he's serving in this great city council, and I salute him. Would you put your hands together and give...

Thank you very much. Let us pray. Gracious and Eternal God, I come to you this day, lifting up the members of our City Council in prayer. I thank you for the many gifts and blessings you have bestowed on them. You have called

NEW YORK CITY COUNCIL STATED MEETING 11 each of them to a position of leadership, and we recognize the weight of that responsibility that they carry. I ask, Dear God, that you will guide them with wisdom, knowledge, and understanding. And Lord, this one, not everyone knows about it, an upper-standing fullness. As they serve our city and its people, grant them discernment to make wise decisions that will uplift our neighborhood. Protect and create opportunity for all. Let integrity be their foundation; justice be their aim, and peace be their legacy. Bless their staff, their family, and loved ones who support them in this work. Renew their energy when testing arises; restore their hope when obstacles seem overwhelming; and above all, remind them that their service matters to you, Holy God, to the City, and to the generations to come. We thank you, and I thank you for their service. And we pray for unity among them to fulfill their duty with skillfulness. I pray that the Lord God of Heaven will bless you and keep you in you're going out and coming in, and cause His face to shine upon you, and grant you his abiding peace. That real Shalom, in the name of

NEW YORK CITY COUNCIL STATED MEETING 12 the Almighty sovereign God, let everyone say Amen. Thank you very much. MAJORITY LEADER FARÍAS: Thank you. I would now ask Council Member Keven Riley to spread the Invocation on the record.

Thank you, Majority Leader. It is my honor to welcome Reverend Dr. Keith Elijah Thompson—who you all heard baptized me when I was a baby. I have the picture if anyone wants to see it— to the Council Chambers today. For over 40 years, Dr. Thompson, known as “the Man” in the community, has been a pillar of faith and leadership in the Northeast Bronx, building institutions, uplifting families, and guiding generations through ministry, education, and service. From the founding of Bronx Miracle Gospel Tabernacle to launching programs that empower our youth and adults alike, his impact has been felt deeply across our district and beyond. Thank you, Majority Leader. I thank Reverend Dr. Thompson for being here today, and I make a motion for unanimous consent to spread the Invocation in full upon the record. Thank you.
